Nottinghamshire County Council
is dedicated to creating a supportive and inclusive environment for children and young people with Special Educational Needs and Disabilities (SEND). We are committed to ensuring that every child has access to high-quality education and care, empowering them to thrive in their communities.

Are you passionate about making a difference in the lives of children and young people with SEND? As the Place Planning Officer (SEND)
, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring that Nottinghamshire has sufficient high-quality SEND education and childcare places for children and young people aged 0-25. You will support the development and delivery of our SEND Place Planning Strategy through insightful analysis of demographic trends and pupil projections.

In This Exciting Role, Your Key Responsibilities Will Include

Forecasting Future Demand: Anticipate the need for SEND places based on demographic data and trends.
Data Management: Manage and analyse complex data to inform strategic decisions.
Collaboration: Work closely with schools, local authorities, planners, and housing developers to ensure SEND needs are integrated into infrastructure planning.
Expert Advice: Provide guidance to senior leaders and elected members on SEND matters.
Funding Support: Assist in securing funding for additional SEND provisions.
New School Establishment: Support the establishment of new SEND schools to meet local needs.

To Succeed In This Role, You Will Need

A degree or equivalent qualification in SEND, Education, Social Care, or a related field.
In-depth knowledge of SEND legislation and statutory processes.
Experience in managing complex data and contributing to strategic planning.
A strong understanding of safeguarding frameworks and quality assurance methodologies.

We Are Looking For Candidates Who Demonstrate

Leadership: Ability to influence and inspire others in a collaborative environment.
Communication: Excellent verbal and written skills to engage diverse audiences.
Analytical Thinking: Strong problem-solving skills, particularly in data-driven decision-making.
Resilience: A commitment to service excellence and personal accountability.

Professional Development: Opportunities for continuous learning and career advancement.

Don’t miss out on this incredible opportunity to make a real difference in your community! If you are ready to take on this rewarding challenge and help shape the future for children and young people with SEND, apply today!

Job Summary

E-Logic, Inc. is seeking a Planner / GIS Analyst
to support the development of a 25-Year Real Property Master Plan
for the Virgin Islands National Guard.

The Planner / GIS Analyst will develop and organize the project's GIS database, compile and analyze spatial information, map existing conditions and planning constraints, and produce professional maps, graphics, and other visual materials supporting the master planning effort.

The selected candidate will work closely with the Senior Master Planner and multidisciplinary project team to support site assessments, land-use analysis, environmental constraint mapping, facility planning, and preparation of the final master plan.

Key Responsibilities

GIS Database Development

Build and organize an installation GIS database from available source information.
Compile, clean, organize, and manage spatial and non-spatial data.
Develop GIS layers for facilities, land use, infrastructure, transportation, environmental constraints, and other relevant planning factors.
Maintain data quality, accuracy, organization, and metadata.

GIS Analysis & Mapping

Map land-use opportunities and constraints supporting long-range installation planning.
Conduct spatial analysis to support land-use and development recommendations.
Analyze existing conditions and spatial relationships among facilities, infrastructure, environmental resources, and development areas.
Integrate GIS information with planning, facility, environmental, and infrastructure data.

Planning Support

Support installation site assessments and field data collection.
Assist the Senior Master Planner with planning analyses and development recommendations.
Support preparation of Area Development Plans and other planning exhibits.
Provide GIS analysis and mapping support for master planning activities.

Maps & Graphics

Produce professional maps, exhibits, graphics, and figures for master plan deliverables.
Prepare maps for stakeholder presentations, planning workshops, and technical reports.
Develop clear and accurate graphics suitable for inclusion in formal planning documents.
Coordinate GIS information with other technical disciplines and project team members.

Documentation & Quality Control

Support documentation and quality control of GIS-related information included in the final master plan.
Verify spatial data and map products for accuracy and consistency.
Assist with preparation of supporting technical documentation and planning materials.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Geography, GIS, Urban Planning, Environmental Science, or a related field.
Minimum 5 years of professional experience in GIS, planning, or a related discipline.
Demonstrated experience developing and maintaining GIS databases.
Experience mapping land-use and environmental constraints.
Experience producing maps and graphics for planning, engineering, environmental, or similar technical documents.
Proficiency with ArcGIS Pro.
Working knowledge of AutoCAD.
Proficiency with Microsoft Office.
Strong analytical and organizational skills.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to work independently in a primarily remote environment.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with DoD GIS data standards.
Experience supporting military installations, National Guard facilities, federal facilities, or military bases.
Installation master planning experience.
Environmental planning or environmental constraints analysis experience.
Experience integrating GIS with land-use, facility, infrastructure, or real property planning.
Federal or DoD project experience.
Experience in the U.S. Virgin Islands, Caribbean, or similar island environments.

This position is primarily remote and part-time

About Portside

Portside is a leading provider of cloud-based software solutions for the global aviation industry. Our platform powers critical operations across business aviation, regional airlines, and aircraft leasing & finance, helping over 1,000 aviation organizations streamline operations, improve decision-making, and operate more efficiently.

Backed by leading technology investors Vista Equity Partners and Insight Partners, Portside is entering an exciting phase of growth. We are expanding our platform, investing in AI driven innovation, and building a global team focused on shaping the future of aviation technology.

Job Summary

Portside is seeking a proactive and customer-focused Customer Success Manager to own a large book of small and medium-sized business (SMB) accounts through a high-volume, tech-enabled motion. Rather than driving every touchpoint yourself, you will manage and continuously improve automated, self-serve processes for onboarding, cadence, support, renewal, and expansion, stepping in personally where accounts need attention, such as inactivity triggers, escalations, or renewal risk.

This role will partner closely with Sales, Product, Marketing, and Support to keep these automated journeys running smoothly, identify where the process needs a human touch, and resolve escalations with strong judgment and people skills. The ideal candidate has experience managing 100+ accounts in a high-volume, tech-enabled Customer Success role, is comfortable using technology and automation to extend their reach, and brings strong interpersonal skills to handle escalations effectively.

Key Responsibilities

Manage and continuously improve the end-to-end customer journey (onboarding, cadence, support, renewal, and expansion) for your book of business.
Handle escalations across your portfolio, using strong judgment and people skills to resolve issues and protect the relationship.
Track customer health, usage, and engagement data to identify where automated processes are working and where a personal touch is needed.
Maintain a deep understanding of Portside's products and underlying technology to effectively advise customers and troubleshoot issues as they're escalated.
Oversee the automated, persona-based onboarding journey, including the internal hand-off from Sales, welcome sequences, and in-app tooltips, stepping in personally when a customer trips a no-activity trigger (e.g., day 14 with no activity) to get onboarding back on track.
Maintain templated, auto-tracked success plans for accounts in your book of business, and oversee automated bi-annual account reviews, email nurture campaigns, and video product tours, refining content and triggers based on performance.
Monitor AI and self-serve support channels (chatbot, release communications, trigger-based outreach) to ensure customers are getting accurate, timely help, and step in on escalations that self-serve support can't resolve.
Oversee automated renewal outreach across your book of business, and take ownership of accounts that escalate to the pooled CSM queue (e.g., 2+ support tickets in 7 days), resolving underlying issues to protect the renewal.
Monitor in-app upgrade prompts and product-led expansion performance across your accounts, flagging trends or friction points to Product and Sales, and identify accounts where a light personal touch could unlock expansion, looping in Sales as appropriate.
Encourage customer participation in Portside's customer community for peer learning, support deflection, and advocacy identification.
Identify customers from your book of business who are strong candidates for testimonials, case studies, referrals, or community advocacy.

Qualifications

At least 5 years in a customer-facing role, including experience in a B2B SaaS environment.
Demonstrated experience using technology and automation to increase reach and efficiency across a large book of business.
Strong people skills, with a track record of effectively handling and resolving customer escalations.
Strong analytical skills, with the ability to interpret usage data and health metrics to prioritize where to step in.
Excellent communication, relationship-building, and problem-solving skills.
Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
Commercial experience (e.g., upsell, cross-sell, or quota-carrying experience) is a strong plus.
Experience with AI-powered Customer Success tools is a strong plus.
Experience in aviation, aerospace, or an adjacent industry, or a genuine passion for aviation is a strong plus.

Fully remote work
Generous time off policy
Health, dental, and vision insurance
Opportunities for professional development and career advancement.
Dynamic, collaborative, and fast-growing work environment.

The Enterprise Cyber GRC (Governance, Risk, and Compliance) team functions as a second line of defense, supporting the development and maintenance of Enterprise Technology (ET) risk management and compliance activities. This is a hands-on execution role, ideal for someone building foundational GRC expertise while contributing to certification lifecycle management, evidence collection, control monitoring, and regulatory reporting support.

Support the Service Manager in maintaining relationships with OGC, the application teams and other across the shared services teams, by preparing documentation, tracking action items, and coordinating meeting logistics.
Coordinate responses to compliance inquiries using GRC tooling, working with SMEs to obtain accurate and complete information in advance of compliance due dates.
Assist in the collection, organization, and validation of evidence artifacts, metrics, and control documentation required for the maintenance of cyber certification and regulatory compliance.
Facilitate detailed risk assessments as part of the risk management program, using GRC software and statistical methods to quantitify risk at the IT asset level.
Help monitor information security controls on an ongoing basis and flag deviations, gaps, or emerging risks to the Service Manager for escalation to the global GRC team.
Coordinate the bi-annual maturity assessment process for selected applications by gathering data, coordinating stakeholder input, and drafting supporting documentation.
Contribute to the preparation of annual reports and governance materials, including drafting content and compiling data for C-level presentations.
Assist in disseminating GRC training materials and coordinating regional awareness sessions, including scheduling, content adaptation, and tracking participation.

Support certification lifecycle activities (e.g., audit scheduling, evidence readiness checks, tracking remediation actions) for relevant frameworks.
Conduct research on regional regulatory requirements and summarize findings to support the Service Manager's representation of regional needs within the global team.
Assist with ad hoc reporting, data analysis, and documentation requests from internal stakeholders, auditors, or the global GRC team.
Assist in preparing and updating of procedural documentation around compliance inquiry management and evidence collection processes.
Bachelor's degree in IT, Cybersecurity, or a relevant business discipline.
2–4 years of relevant IT, security, or compliance experience.
Exposure to security frameworks such as NIST CSF or ISO 27001 preferred.
Experience supporting audits, assessments, or compliance projects is a plus.
